title: Final scope reconciliation and complete final protocol freeze
purpose: Freeze the final confirmatory scope, claim boundaries, evaluation rules, statistics, XAI and reporting rules before untouched final seeds are selected or final test arrays are materialized.

evidence_boundaries.task45: Overall preregistered result PARTIAL; H1 detection robustness failed; H2 mitigation passed; H3 attack-scale nondecreasing passed; negative/boundary results retained.

final_method.detector: independent historical anchor plus robust current-round consensus over 8x8 class-conditional transition signatures with temporal EMA and instantaneous rescue
final_method.reconstruction: center_plus_residual trusted update reconstruction preserving original client sample weights
final_method.xai_role: post-detection forensic explanation only; not a primary detector or aggregation authority
final_method.llm_role: grounded report surface realization only; no authority over security decisions or deterministic fact selection

final_evaluation_freeze.task64_seed_policy: Select and register new untouched final seeds only after Task63 freeze. Development seeds 7,42,99,123,2026 are ineligible as fully untouched final seeds.
final_evaluation_freeze.task65_test_policy: Natural and diagnostic final test arrays may be materialized only after Task64. Evaluate the frozen final methods once. No retuning, threshold changes, attack-specific adaptation, best-run selection, or claim-threshold changes after outcome inspection.
final_evaluation_freeze.final_attack_scope: Only attack conditions explicitly frozen by the Task63 evaluation manifest created before Task64 are confirmatory. Deferred Tasks46-54 cannot be silently reintroduced.
final_evaluation_freeze.baselines_policy: Only baselines with frozen, reproducible implementations and parameterization before Task64 may enter confirmatory comparison.

statistics_freeze.unit_of_pairing: same final seed and matched experimental condition
statistics_freeze.primary_inference: paired nonparametric or paired bootstrap inference chosen in the Task63 final evaluation manifest before Task64; no test shopping after outcomes
statistics_freeze.multiple_comparisons: Holm family-wise adjustment for prespecified families of multiple primary comparisons
